request: Investigate why order ORD-1004 is late.

steps.text: Checking order details to verify promised date, fulfillment status, warehouse, and items so I can determine if it's overdue and what to check next.
Checking shipment tracking to see status, current location/ETA, and any recorded delay reason, since the order has shipped and is overdue.
Checking for any Lone Star Parcel service alerts in Little Rock, AR to explain the stalled tracking with no recorded delay reason.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1004 is overdue; the shipment shows no movement since 2026-03-07 in Little Rock, AR and has no current ETA or recorded delay reason.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1004 promised_delivery_date 2026-03-10; fulfillment_status SHIPPED; fulfillment_warehouse_id WH-DAL.
get_shipment_status: SHP-5004 via Lone Star Parcel, tracking LSP-40417, status IN_TRANSIT; dispatch_date 2026-03-05 (dispatched_late false).
get_shipment_status: last_event_date 2026-03-07 at Little Rock, AR; days_since_last_event 9; current_estimated_delivery_date null; recorded_delay_reason null.
get_carrier_alerts: Lone Star Parcel at Little Rock, AR alert_count 0 (no matching service alerts).
arguments.likely_cause: Tracking has stalled since 2026-03-07 at Little Rock, AR with no recorded delay reason or matching carrier alerts.
uncertainties: Current location of the package and whether it is held, misrouted, or lost.
Carrier’s reason for the delay and a confirmed new ETA.
Whether further movement will occur without intervention.

recommended_actions.details: Open a trace with Lone Star Parcel for tracking LSP-40417 to obtain current location and a delivery commitment, citing get_shipment_status: last scan 2026-03-07 at Little Rock, AR; is_overdue true by 6 days; current_estimated_delivery_date null; recorded_delay_reason null.

Inform Fabrikam Foods that the shipment is delayed beyond the 2026-03-10 promise and tracking has not updated since 2026-03-07 in Little Rock, AR (per get_shipment_status), and that we have requested a carrier trace; share the updated ETA once received.

arguments.recommendation: Contact Lone Star Parcel immediately for a trace and provide the customer a delay notice and follow-up with the confirmed ETA.
missing_information: Carrier trace results: current location, reason for delay, and updated ETA.
